summary: Iteration 8 bug-fix backend smoke: 10/10 tests passed. Verified MongoDB indexes startup log, invite auto-activation (both via register and via get_current_user for already-logged-in users), and cancel-training endpoint (queued -> cancelled, training -> flag set, terminal -> 400, missing -> 404, non-owner -> 403). Regression on /auth/me and /projects passes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2105 lines — recommend splitting into routers (auth, teams, projects, models, comments, notifications) for maintainability.

_activate_pending_invites is called on every authenticated request via get_current_user; wrapped in try/except which swallows all errors silently. Consider logging exceptions instead of pass so real DB failures don't go unnoticed.
cancel_model_training uses two separate awaited updates when status was 'queued'; could be combined into a single $set update for atomicity.

invite_member returns 400 'User already a member' even if the existing row is 'pending' — inconsistent with the auto-activation flow (owner can't re-invite to fix a stale pending row). Consider idempotent upsert.
test_credentials: demo@vf.io / demo1234; fresh users registered per test with uuid emails
seed_data_creation: Inserted fake model docs (status=queued/training/trained/cancelled/failed) directly via pymongo to avoid running real YOLO training. Inserted one pending team_members row to simulate the exact fix scenario for get_current_user auto-activation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: bugfix_smoke.py covers invite auto-activation (2 paths) + cancel endpoint (5 cases). To test full cancel-during-training flow with real YOLO, would need 30+ approved images seeded — deferred as too slow per request.
rca of the issue: N/A — this iteration verified fixes; no new bugs found.
